parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Unit: seconds. If you do not set this parameter, the end time is the current query time.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Unit: seconds.
